item.title: Client money in legal services: Notifying the SRA of changes to help identify and act on risks

proposed_record.title: Firms to notify the SRA of mergers and of starting to hold client money proposed
proposed_record.summary: The SRA has proposed a rule requiring firms to notify it of events it prescribes. The first two events would be planned mergers or acquisitions and starting to hold client money.
what_changes: A new rule would require firms to notify the SRA of any notifiable event it prescribes from time to time.
Firms would have to pre-notify the SRA of a merger or acquisition once it reaches the Heads of Terms stage or equivalent.
Firms would have to notify the SRA within 28 days of starting to receive or hold client money, if they had previously reported they did not.
The SRA could use fixed financial penalties for late or incomplete notifications.
proposed_record.who_it_applies_to: All SRA-regulated firms, especially those planning a merger or acquisition and those starting to hold client money for the first time.

history.event: Consultation closed on 17 August 2026; SRA has published a webinar on proposed next steps.
